translated: I'm always so grateful to my manager. Thank you so much.
For me, I can work hard once I flip the switch.
I tend to get things done early, but once that switch turns off, I really start putting everything off.
That work switch is so important.
It would be nice if that switch just stayed on all the time.
My off-switch is just too strong.
[CORNER: Listener Mail] Okay, next we have one from Radio name: Mutsuki.
"Hello to Rina Honnizumi-san and Minori Suzuki-san. Kon-more, kon-niigo."
"I was recently grinding a ProSeka event, and I had Sekaraji playing the whole time I was doing laps."
"The cast's talk was so funny and soothing that the time just flew by."
"Do you two have anything that helps you get work done?"
